item.title: Yann LeCun to depart Meta and launch AI startup focused on 'world models'
Simulating a Planet on the GPU: Part 1 (2022)
item.description:
📝 While I liked the direction this adventure in compute shaders had taken me, I needed some new technique which could realistically deform crust at convergent plate boundaries. Could I simulate little bits of “crust” which could bump into one another, forming mountains and valleys. More in depth, I’d highly recommend this incredible talk on compute shader performance optimization.
🔗 Read more: https://www.patrickcelentano.com/blog/planet-sim-part-1

item.title: You will own nothing and be (un)happy
item.description:
📝 From food delivery apps to beer subscription. People might just sigh, mutter “this bloody subscription rahhh,” and cancel it so it won’t charge them again. They won’t disappear, not unless they find something more profitable.
🔗 Read more: https://racc.blog/you-will-own-nothing-and-be-unhappy/
